name: SVC_CHAT_MESSAGES
description: This table is used to store Chat Messages. References SVC_CHATS

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CHAT_ROLE_CD
columns.description: Role of the person that posted the message (AGENT, END_USER).

columns.name: MESSAGE_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The type of message as received from the Chat Service

columns.name: POSTED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the Party ID of the person who posted the message. This person can be an internal resource or a customer contact.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CONTENT
columns.description: Content of the chat message. Null for system messages.

columns.name: RICH_TEXT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the message content is in rich text format (Y or N).

columns.name: VISIBILITY_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the audience of the message (ALL, NOT_END_USER).

columns.name: MESSAGE_DATE
columns.description: Date the message was sent if the message was sent.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this message is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: MERCURY_WORK_ID
columns.description: Mercury Work Id, if it exists.
